title: Digital Product Payment Solutions in West Africa: How One Creator Went from Zero to Live in 48 Hours
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: In Nigeria, digital creators face significant challenges in selling their products online due to restrictions on platforms like Stripe and PayPal, limiting their ability to reach international buyers. This infrastructure gap hinders the growth of their businesses, making it essential to find alternative solutions. The COREMERCH sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a viable alternative, enabling creators to deploy their own digital commerce stacks and accept crypto payments seamlessly.
The Situation Before the Stack

Before discovering COREMERCH, many digital creators in West Africa struggled to find reliable payment solutions for their online businesses. The lack of access to conventional payment platforms forced them to rely on cumbersome workarounds, leading to lost sales and frustrated customers. This situation highlighted the need for a more robust and independent infrastructure that could bypass these restrictions and facilitate smooth transactions.
Why Conventional Options Had Already Failed

Conventional payment options had failed these creators due to the restrictive nature of their terms and conditions. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal often have strict requirements and geographical limitations, making it difficult for creators from certain regions to access their services. This led to a search for more inclusive and flexible solutions that could cater to their specific needs and allow them to compete on a global scale.
The Infrastructure That Was Deployed

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the server operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. GitHub Pages is backed by Microsoft's global infrastructure. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Blockchain-based payments eliminate geographical restrictions in digital commerce.
What Happened After Going Live

After deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, the creator was able to go live within 48 hours, loading five digital products and configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for secure email communications. The automatic crypto payment verification through NOWPayments ensured that transactions were processed efficiently, with the creator maintaining full control over their sales and customer data. This marked a significant turnaround in their ability to sell digital products globally.
The Lessons That Apply to Your Situation

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost, under their own accounts, with full data ownership from day one.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer. The delivery email arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. Nothing in this sequence requires the buyer to have a bank account, a credit card, or a PayPal account. Nothing requires you to be in a supported country.
Infrastructure sovereignty is key to unlocking global sales potential.
